# MyClip ⇄ Maccy parity inventory

**Contract target: Maccy 2.7.1** (p0deje/Maccy, MIT, tag `2.7.1`). This file is generated from Maccy's `Defaults.Keys+Names.swift`, `KeyboardShortcuts.Name+Shortcuts.swift`, Settings panes tree, and README @ 2.7.1. Every row must map to a milestone or an approved deviation. "Milestone" tags: M1 engine, M2 UI, M3 paste, M4 settings/i18n, M5 ship.

## 1. Engine / storage

| Maccy key/behavior (2.7.1) | Default | MyClip plan | MS |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipboardCheckInterval` | 0.5s | poll loop param, min bound 100ms; changeCount via purego, read data only on change | M1/M4 |
| `size` (historySize) | 200 | SQLite store cap, LRU trim excl. pins | M1/M4 |
| `enabledPasteboardTypes` | all: text(html,rtf,string) + images(png,tiff,jpeg,heic) + files(fileURL) | per-type toggles; raw-UTI capture model | M1/M4 |
| `ignoredPasteboardTypes` | 5 defaults (1Password, typeit4me, TransientPasteboard, keeweb, "Pasteboard generator type") | filter set + prefs editor; always-ignore trio org.nspasteboard.{Transient,Concealed,AutoGenerated}Type | M1/M4 |
| `ignoredApps` + `ignoreAllAppsExceptListed` | [], false | frontmost bundle ID at copy time (purego NSWorkspace shim); allowlist mode | M1/M4 |
| `ignoreRegexp` | [] | content regex filter | M1/M4 |
| `ignoreEvents` / `ignoreOnlyNextEvent` | false | pause capture / skip next; tray ⌥click / ⌥⇧click + menu fallback | M1+M2 |
| `sortBy` | lastCopiedAt | sort: lastCopiedAt / firstCopiedAt / numberOfCopies | M1/M4 |
| own-write suppression | `.fromMaccy` marker UTI + changeCount bookkeeping | marker UTI `com.l92labs.myclip.own-write` + changeCount watermark | M1 |
| item model | one item, N representations, source app, first/last copy time, copy count, pin, title | same schema (SQLite) | M1 |
| write-back fidelity | restore all captured types incl. private UTIs | round-trip spike: RTF/TIFF/private UTI/multi-file; purego `setData:forType:` fallback if transfer model lossy | M1 |
| data at rest | Core Data/SQLite plaintext | SQLite: 0600 file in 0700 dir, secure_delete on delete/clear/clearOnQuit, per-item size cap, total DB budget, >64MiB item graceful skip | M1 |

## 3. Paste-back (M3)

| Behavior | Plan |
|---|---|
| `pasteByDefault` (default false) | select ⇒ copy (+paste if enabled) |
| `removeFormattingByDefault` (default false) + ⌥⇧ paste plain | write only text representation |
| simulated ⌘V | CGEvent via purego; **Accessibility TCC only**; capture frontmost app before popup, activate-then-post w/ bounded wait; no osascript fallback (avoid 2nd Automation TCC) |
| keyboard layout | keycode from current layout via TIS/UCKeyTranslate; force QWERTY V when layout name ends `⌘`; evidence on QWERTY/AZERTY/Dvorak |

## 5. Settings window panes (M4)

General / Appearance / Ignore (Applications + Pasteboard Types + Regexps tabs) / Pins / Storage / Advanced — every control above lives here; ⌘, opens.

## 6. Approved deviations (user sign-off required)

| # | Deviation | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| D1 | App Intents (Select/Get/Clear/Delete) → replaced by `myclip://` URL scheme usable from Shortcuts "Open URL" | App Intents framework not callable from pure Go; URL scheme keeps automation parity |
| D2 | Translations: 3 languages (EN/FR/+1) vs Maccy's full set | user directive |
| D3 | Sparkle auto-update → MyGo updater with `DisableAutomaticChecks: true`, opt-in "Check for Updates" | local-only constraint N1 |
| D4 | `lastReviewRequestedAt`, `numberOfUsages` skipped | App Store review nags / usage counter — anti-features here |
| D5 | `defaults write` CLI editing not available | prefs live in MyClip config store, not NSUserDefaults |
